name: 25/10 Crowd Sourcing
deliverable: High-velocity anonymous card exchange scoring boldest breakthrough ideas

steps.text: Give everyone a card: write a bold action for the bottleneck on top and its first step below, with no name.
Have them draw five scoring rows on the back, ready to mark each card they see from one to five.
Run five shuffle rounds: pass cards continuously, stop, read the card in hand, discuss briefly, score privately.
Keep each round's score hidden from the author and leave earlier scores untouched.
Total the five scores and call the countdown from twenty-five down, reading out the highest cards.

failure: Scorers cluster on safe threes, so every card lands near fifteen and the room cannot tell a bold idea from a polite one.
intervention: Say: "A three is a refusal to judge. Score a platitude one and a courageous, actionable idea five. Use the whole scale."
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.title: The Surprising Power of Liberating Structures
